Ready to kick-start your engineering career on some of Southeast Queensland’s most exciting infrastructure projects?
Seymour Whyte's Graduate Program gives ambitious engineering graduates the opportunity to work on major projects, take on real responsibility from day one, and develop the technical, commercial and leadership skills needed for a successful career in construction.
Through our structured two-year development program, you'll gain hands-on experience across major civil infrastructure projects, work alongside industry leaders, receive dedicated mentoring and build the skills and confidence to accelerate your career.  You'll be trusted with real responsibility, supported to grow and given the opportunity to make a genuine impact while helping deliver infrastructure that connects communities.
If you're ready to learn, grow and help shape the future, we'd love to hear from you.
About the Project
We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Civil Engineer to join our Cressbrook Dam Safety Improvement Project, a major infrastructure upgrade that will strengthen the dam's flood capacity, improve resilience to extreme weather events and enhance long-term community safety.
This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience on a complex and high-profile project while working alongside experienced industry professionals. You'll be exposed to a broad range of civil engineering disciplines and play a meaningful role in delivering infrastructure that will benefit local communities for generations to come.
Located in the picturesque Toowoomba region, this role offers the chance to build your career in a supportive project environment while enjoying the benefits of regional living.
The successful candidate will be required to work away from home, with attractive living away from home (LAFHA) and project allowances provided.
Why Join Seymour Whyte?
At Seymour Whyte, we believe the best way to learn is by doing. Our structured Graduate Development Program is designed to fast-track your career through hands-on project experience, mentoring from industry leaders and tailored professional development opportunities.
From day one, you'll be embedded in a live project team, contributing to the delivery of major infrastructure projects that shape communities across Australia. You'll gain exposure to a range of disciplines, build your technical and commercial acumen and develop the confidence to take ownership of meaningful work early in your career.
Throughout the program, you'll be supported by experienced mentors, participate in structured development workshops, and connect with a national network of graduates and professionals who are invested in your success.
What's in it for you?
- Work on a landmark civil infrastructure project from day one
- Gain exposure to multiple disciplines across project delivery
- Receive structured mentoring, coaching and development support
- Learn from experienced industry leaders and subject matter experts
- Build a strong professional network across projects and regions
- Be part of a collaborative, supportive and high-performing team culture
- Access career opportunities within the VINCI Group, a global leader in construction, infrastructure and concessions
Whether your passion lies in construction delivery, engineering, project management or leadership, our Graduate Development Program will provide the foundation, support and opportunities to help you build a rewarding and long-term career with Seymour Whyte.
To learn more about our Graduate Program, click here.
About You
You're in your final year of a Bachelor of Civil Engineering and ready to turn everything you've learned into real-world experience on major infrastructure projects.
Whether you've gained experience through an internship, vacation work, industry placement or part-time employment, you're eager to learn, build your skills and make a meaningful contribution from day one.
We're looking for graduates who are curious, motivated and excited about a career in civil construction.
You'll bring:
- Final-year studies in a Bachelor of Civil Engineering
- Practical experience through internships, vacation programs, placements or other employment
- A genuine passion for civil construction and infrastructure projects
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn from experienced industry professionals
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- A commitment to safety, collaboration and creating a positive team culture
- Flexibility to travel or relocate as opportunities arise throughout your career
Most importantly, you're ready to take the next step, embrace new challenges and build a rewarding career delivering projects that make a lasting impact on communities across Australia.
Seymour Whyte Benefits
- Employee recognition and awards that celebrate contribution and achievement
- An employee share program, providing the opportunity to invest in the long-term success of the business
- Birthday leave, because celebrating life's milestones matters
- The option to purchase additional leave to support travel, study or personal commitments
- Fitness and wellbeing discounts through WHEREFIT (gym memberships, meal plans and fitness brands)
- Travel, retail, lifestyle and wellness discounts
- Workplace banking benefits and everyday financial savings through CommBank and Flare
Seymour Whyte is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds, including veterans.
Our commitment to an equitable construction industry extends to an inclusive culture that embraces our differences and gives everyone the opportunity to grow and be equally valued. We're unified in our direction toward having a workplace that is balanced and fair for all.
Next Steps:
- Submit your CV online to apply for this role
- All successful applicants will be required to undergo a pre-employment medical and criminal history check
- Applications will only be accepted from candidates who have the right to work in Australia
To learn more about us, visit www.seymourwhyte.com.au

Company Description
Egis is a leading global organisation in architecture, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services. We partner with clients to design, deliver and operate smarter infrastructure and places that respond to the world’s evolving needs.
With more than 22,000 employees worldwide, we combine global capability with strong local insight. Our multidisciplinary expertise enables us to deliver innovative, practical and sustainable solutions that help build more balanced, resilient communities.
At Egis, you’ll be part of a business shaping the future of cities, transport, energy and the built environment, creating lasting impact where it matters most.
Job Description
Step into a role where your ideas and curiosity genuinely matter. As a Graduate Engineer, you’ll contribute to real projects from your first week.
You’ll support technical analysis using GIS, water and flood modelling software across a variety of projects. Join our dynamic and high-performing Water team for the 2027 Graduate intake!
What we offer you
- Peer Mentorship: with a dedicated buddy system gain guidance and support from emerging young professionals within your industry.
- Continuous Learning: collaborate, problem solve and thrive in a supportive environment.
- Hands-on Experience: conduct flood modelling, water balance modelling and mine water management, turning information into insights that matter.
- Collaboration: as your career develops, work closely with experts across the water resources, environmental management, flooding and stormwater teams.
Key responsibilities
- 
Teamwork: you’ll work alongside a variety of specialists, learning how different disciplines come together to deliver successful projects. Building relationships with clients on projects and developing contacts within the industry.
- 
Problem Solving: tackle real challenges, think creatively and help shape practical solutions that improve project performance outcomes. Apply diligent curiosity across a variety of analysis and modelling activities.
- 
Quality Focus: learn how we meet industry standards and regulations while delivering work we’re proud of.
Qualifications
What do we need from you
- Graduating prior to commencing full-time work in February 2027
- Tertiary degree in Civil Engineering or Environmental Engineering
- Available to start February 2027
- Relevant work rights to live and work full-time in Australia. This position is not open to applicants outside of Australia
About you
- Excellent communication skills, written and verbal
- Strong willingness to learn and grow professionally
- Interest and enthusiasm to work within water resources
- Detail orientated and analytical
- Exposure to GIS software, as well as flood modelling and/or water balance modelling is highly regarded.
- Previous vacation or internship experience within the mining industry, local government or a consulting environment will be highly regarded
Additional Information
Egis is committed to creating an inclusive, creative culture that embraces diversity and flexibility. We offer generous parental leave, support flexible work practices and strive to create an environment where employees can connect, collaborate, grow and succeed.
We are expanding in Australia and New Zealand and are excited for you to join our growing team!
TO APPLY
Please attach your resume, cover letter and academic transcripts in one file.
We believe our strong graduate program will provide you with the tools you need to start your career the right way.

candidates.content_text:
Civil Designer – 12d Specialist
Helensvale / Gold Coast 
High‑quality commercial & residential projects, land development • Strong team • Real progression
EDGE Consulting Engineers is a fast‑growing Australian-owned Structural & Civil consultancy delivering high‑quality development and building projects across QLD, NSW, VIC and Australia-wide. With a strong pipeline of commercial, residential and mixed‑use work, we’re expanding our civil design capability in Helensvale.
We’re seeking a Intermediate to Senior Civil Designer with 12d capability and strong experience across commercial, residential civil design & land development. This role suits a designer who wants ownership, technical influence, and the chance to shape civil delivery within a collaborative, high-performance team.
EDGE supports relocation packages for the right candidate, from NSW or elsewhere in QLD. 
Why Join EDGE?
At EDGE, designers are trusted, supported, and given real opportunities to grow.
You’ll gain:
- A high-performance, supportive civil team
- Exposure to quality commercial, residential projects & land development.
- Direct collaboration with Civil Leads and Directors
- A strong technical and QA framework
- Opportunities to mentor junior designers
- Flexible working arrangements
- Ongoing professional development
- Collaboration with national project teams
- A positive workplace culture where people enjoy coming to work
About the Role – Civil Design (12d)
You will lead and contribute to civil design packages for land development, commercial and residential building projects, working closely with senior engineers and multidisciplinary teams.
Typical projects include:
- Commercial building developments
- Residential estates
- Mixed-use developments
- Urban infill and redevelopment sites
- Siteworks supporting structural building projects
- Land subdivisions
This is a civil design role focused on development and building projects.
Key Responsibilities
- Deliver civil design packages using 12d modelling
- Prepare siteworks, earthworks, drainage and services designs
- Produce civil drawings, documentation and mark-ups
- Assist with concept, tender and construction documentation
- Undertake design analysis using industry software
- Attend client and project team meetings
- Contribute to project delivery within scope, time and budget
- Participate in internal design reviews and QA processes
- Assist with technical documentation and reporting
- Collaborate with structural and civil teams across offices
About You
You’re a motivated civil designer with strong development-sector experience and deep capability in 12d. You want to step into a senior role where your technical skill and judgement genuinely influence project outcomes.
You will have:
- 3+ years civil design experience in consultancy
- Advanced proficiency in 12d
- Strong experience in land development, commercial or residential civil design
- Solid understanding of siteworks, drainage, earthworks and services design
- Experience producing civil drawings for development/building projects
- Proficiency with CAD platforms
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- Ability to apply sound engineering judgement
- Commitment to professional development
Join EDGE on the Gold Coast
If you’re a Intermediate to Senior Civil Designer ready to take ownership, lead technically, and work on high-quality development and building projects in one of Queensland’s best coastal regions, we’d love to hear from you.
Applications close: 15th November 2026
Applicants must have full Australian working rights.
EDGE is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and equitable workplace.

candidates.content_text:
We're seeking a Digital Engineering Coordinator to join our Central Region team, supporting the delivery of major infrastructure projects across Canberra, Sydney and surrounding regions.
Initially, you'll be embedded within the landmark Icon Water Lower Molonglo Water Quality Control Centre Upgrade, one of Canberra's largest and most significant water infrastructure projects.
As the business continues to grow throughout the Central Region, you'll also have the opportunity to contribute to a diverse portfolio of major civil, water and infrastructure projects, providing exposure to a variety of project environments, teams and delivery challenges.
This role offers flexibility to be based in either Canberra or Sydney, with occasional travel to project sites and offices across the region as required. It's an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working across multiple stakeholders, influencing project outcomes and driving innovation in Digital Engineering practices.
Working across design, construction and project delivery teams, you'll play a key role in coordinating BIM models, managing digital workflows and driving collaboration to support safe, efficient and high quality project outcomes.
We're looking for someone with advanced proficiency in Revit and Navisworks, strong knowledge of ISO 19650 and industry BIM standards, and experience coordinating multidisciplinary models within major infrastructure environments. If you're passionate about BIM, VDC and digital delivery, this is an opportunity to build your career across some of Australia's most exciting infrastructure projects while helping shape the future of Digital Engineering within Seymour Whyte.
About Seymour Whyte:
We are a successful civil contracting business that has been operating in Australia for over 35 years. With the agility and personal connection of a Tier 2, yet the expertise of a Tier 1, and the enhanced resources of one of the largest, world-class construction companies, VINCI, our employees and clients get the best of three worlds.
As a progressive, leading civil engineering firm built on the strong foundations of our unique history, we engage, enable and empower our people to be better. With you, we are altogether stronger, in building the future we want. 
How You'll Contribute:
- Lead and coordinate Digital Engineering activities across multidisciplinary design and construction teams
- Managing federated BIM models and digital deliverables throughout the project lifecycle
- Lead model reviews, clash detection, constructability reviews and coordination workshops
- Support VDC activities including 4D planning, construction sequencing and Safety in Design
- Manage digital issues and drive their resolution across project stakeholders
- Implement and maintain DE standards, workflows, QA processes and information management requirements
- Ensure compliance with ISO 19650, project DE requirements, client standards and project objectives
- Support digital asset information and project handover requirements
- Mentor project teams and identify opportunities for digital innovation, automation and improved project delivery
What You'll Bring: You will be an experienced Digital Engineering/BIM professional with:
- 5+ years' experience in Digital Engineering, BIM coordination or a similar role within infrastructure or construction
- Demonstrated experience coordinating multidisciplinary BIM models across civil, structural, drainage, roads and utilities
- Strong understanding of BIM coordination, model federation, clash detection, information management and CDE workflows
- Experience with ISO 19650 and industry BIM standards
- Advanced capability in Revit and Navisworks, with experience in Revizto and Civil 3D
- Experience with CDE platforms such as Autodesk Construction Cloud/Forma, ProjectWise, Synergy or equivalent
- An understanding of BIM/GIS interoperability and digital information workflows
- Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to lead workshops, influence project teams and drive adoption of DE practices
- A collaborative, organised and proactive approach, with a strong focus on quality and delivery
Seymour Whyte benefits:
- Workplace banking benefits and everyday financial discounts
- Birthday leave, recognising the importance of personal milestones
- The option to purchase additional leave to support travel, study or life commitments
- Travel benefits, along with retail, lifestyle and wellness discounts
- Fitness & wellbeing discounts through WHEREFIT (gym, meal plans, fitness brands)
- Shopping and lifestyle discounts via Flare and CommBank Workplace Banking
- Structured career pathways with opportunities for global mobility
- Leadership development programs and one‑on‑one mentoring to support professional growth
- Employee recognition and awards that acknowledge contribution and achievement
- An employee share program, providing the opportunity to invest in the long‑term success of the business
Many of our projects are located in regional areas or on sites without access to public transport, therefore all applicants must hold a current Driver’s Licence and have their own transport. 
Seymour Whyte is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds, including veterans.
Our commitment to an equitable construction industry extends to an inclusive culture that embraces our differences and gives everyone the opportunity to grow and be equally valued. We're unified in our direction toward having a workplace that is balanced and fair for all.
Next steps
- Submit your CV online to apply for this role
- All successful applicants will be required to undergo a pre-employment medical and criminal history check.
- Applications will only be accepted from candidates who have the right to work in Australia
Register on our website for job alerts to be advised when new roles become available.  https://careers.seymourwhyte.com.au/en/listing/
To learn more about us, visit www.seymourwhyte.com.au

About the role 
We're looking for an experienced Survey Draftperson to join our QLD Drafting team, reporting to the Team Leader, Drafting Services. This is a hands-on support role for someone who already has a background in survey drafting and is ready to apply it across large-scale greenfields subdivision and infrastructure projects. 
You'll turn field and design data into accurate, high-quality deliverables, including survey plans, lot calculations, topographic feature survey plans and Digital Terrain Models. You'll also interpret engineering design plans, prepare set-out calculations and field upload packages, and compare as-constructed data against design to pick up variances and quality issues before they reach the client. 
Previous experience in survey drafting is essential. You'll be working alongside some of the most experienced professionals in the industry, with plenty of opportunity to cross-train, share knowledge and keep building your skills. 
Who we are 
McMullen Nolan Group (MNG) was formed in 1989 to provide alternative survey services to the land development industry. Since then, we've been dedicated to delivering personalised, innovative spatial solutions to the Land Development and Engineering & Infrastructure sectors across Australia. Our core focus is survey services for large-scale greenfields subdivision clients, backed by award-winning laser scanning technology. Today, MNG is one of the pre-eminent survey businesses in Australia. 
Our values guide everything we do: Teamwork, Innovation and Knowledge. 
What we offer 
 - The opportunity to work alongside some of the most experienced and well-regarded professionals in the industry
 - Exciting and diverse projects across Queensland and New South Wales, including award-winning land developments and infrastructure projects
 - A supportive, people-focused team culture that promotes growth, learning, professional membership and work-life balance
 - Flexible working options and access to paid overtime
 - Cross-training and knowledge sharing with peers, so your skills keep growing 
What's involved in the role 
As a Survey Draftperson, you'll play a key support role in our QLD Drafting team, reporting to the Team Leader – Drafting Services. You will: 
 - Use AutoCAD, 12d and Civil 3D to create, amend and maintain survey plans, including lot calculations and topographic feature survey plans
 - Create and manage Digital Terrain Models (DTMs)
 - Interpret engineering design plans and incorporate design data into project deliverables
 - Prepare engineering base data for Disclosure Plans
 - Complete construction set-out calculations and prepare field upload packages
 - Compare as-constructed survey data against design documentation and identify variances
 - Validate survey data and flag discrepancies, errors or quality issues 
What you'll need 
 - Knowledge of AutoCAD, 12d, Civil 3D or a similar CAD program
 - Demonstrated knowledge of technical drawing or industrial graphics
 - Good mathematical ability
 - Strong attention to detail and good visual skills
 - Effective analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Good oral and written communication skills
 - The ability to work well as part of a team and meet delivery timeframes
 - A willingness and ability to learn to read and interpret engineering design plans and standard survey plans
 - Must have experience in Survey Drafting

candidates.content_text:
Make your mark with Thiess  
Everyday, all around the world, Thiess supports and celebrates our people. We recognise talent and reward transparency. We champion diversity and embrace change.  
Join us. Hone your skills and develop new ones. Take on big challenges and grow, through mentorship, collaboration and empowerment.  
Thiess is the place to make things happen.  
About The Opportunity 
The Thiess Cadetship Program provides a pathway into professional Technical Services roles across our projects. We support employees to study part-time while continuing to work full time gaining real hands-on experience working in a functional technical team.  Thiess will reimburse the costs of study fees upon successful completion of each course.   
If you’ve thought about advancing your career in mining, this is your chance to do so in a supportive environment where you can learn on the job, enjoy flexibility to study and have your course fees paid for. 
Additional support will be provided through programs including the Thiess Graduate Advisor Program and Graduate Development Modules and Graduate Mining Education Series.
Our cadetships program is currently offered for disciplines including mining engineering, survey and other technical disciplines (on a case by case basis).  Each agreement is tailored to the applicant’s individual circumstances and field of study, but nominally four years duration if completing a two-year associate degree part time.   At least two rotations in different roles, projects and functions related to their discipline of study will be offered.
About You

Please note that this role will be a permanent position and applications for this role will close at midnight on Tuesday 20 October.  
What Thiess Can Do for You 
- Help to grow your career, offering diverse and varied opportunities for advancement 
- Flexible working arrangements 
- World-class health & wellbeing programs  
- Salary sacrifice options  
- A range of corporate discounts, including health insurance (Medibank), travel & retail products  
About Us 
At Thiess, we partner with our clients to deliver excellence in open cut and underground mining in Australia, Asia and the Americas. For more than 85 years, we have operated in diverse commodities, geologies, environments and cultures. Our team uses global insight to optimise solutions and create value for each project, positioning them for optimal efficiency, productivity and cost performance, backed by how we meet our commitments. Thiess is committed to being at the forefront of sustainable mining, leveraging the power of our people and technology to support clients in their journey to more sustainable enterprises. 
We recognise the value of an inclusive and diverse workplace through our vision of everyone matters always. We’re focused on creating an inclusive environment to allow our people to bring their best self to work because they feel safe, included and empowered. 
How to Apply 
This role is an opportunity to take the next step in your career. With our culture of recognition, development, and a stimulating and satisfying work environment, there is no better time to join Thiess.
